item.title: COP31 climate talks collapse as EU and others reject deal
item.description: UN climate talks have collapsed as the EU and others rejected a final draft deal, saying it was too weak to advance the fight against global warming.

item.title: Govt to consider use of plug-in solar panels from April
item.description: Householders could be permitted to buy and use plug-in solar panels from next spring under new energy affordability measures to be discussed by Cabinet later today.

item.title: Just 30% of small electrical items being recycled - WEEE
item.description: Just three in 10 small electrical items are coming back for recycling when they reach the end of their useful life, according to new figures.

item.title: Ireland 'scratching the surface' on food waste - charity
item.description: Food waste remains a significant problem in Ireland, with tonnes of perfectly edible food being discarded every day.

item.title: COP31 draft climate deal removes mention of fossil fuels
item.description: A new draft agreement at the COP31 climate summit in Antalya has removed all references to transitioning away from fossil fuels and dropped a proposed $120 billion target for climate adaptation.
